messages.author: Oscar Lindqvist
messages.text: Organic Android installs doubled yesterday (8.2k vs ~4.0k). Did we get featured on the store or something?

replies.author: Hana Kobayashi
replies.text: Not that I know of, no featuring on the calendar.

replies.author: Kwame Asante
replies.text: Look at Google Android on the same day: installs dropped by roughly the same amount (~4.3k) while Google clicks stayed normal. Total Android installs are flat. So it's not new demand, it's Google installs losing attribution and falling into Organic. Following up in #ua-team.
